guideDescription: macOS asks for two permissions before your first recording. Turn them on in System Settings and this window updates as soon as you do.
screenDescription: Lets Screenforge capture your screen. Recordings stay on your Mac.
accessibilityDescription: Lets Screenforge follow your cursor, clicks and keyboard shortcuts, so auto-zoom knows where to look.
relaunchHint: Turned it on but Screenforge still hasn't noticed? macOS sometimes only applies the change after a restart.
allSet: You're all set. Start a recording whenever you're ready.
emptyStateHint: Or try the editor, auto-zoom and export on a short sample first.
